canonical_title: Steps for Adapting Existing Learning Materials

one_line_answer.text: Adapting existing materials usually requires less time and fewer resources than developing new materials.

bangla_explanation: নতুন material বানানোর চেয়ে existing materials adapt করলে সময় আর খরচ কম লাগে।
এর জন্য সাতটা ধাপ আছে: needs দেখা থেকে শুরু করে adapted material evaluate করা পর্যন্ত।
Pilot test মানে target audience-কে দিয়ে আগে material review করানো।
Mass produced করার আগে pilot test করলে টাকা আর সময় দুটোই বাঁচে।

short.prompt: Write the steps for evaluating and adapting existing learning materials.
short.modelAnswer:
Adapting existing materials needs less time and fewer resources. Steps:
1. Assess needs and resources
2. Evaluate the material
3. Find out whether you need permission
4. Pilot test with members of your audience
5. Make changes based on pilot test
6. Finalize and implement
7. Evaluate your adapted material

keyPoints.text: Pilot testing lets the target audience review materials before they are finalized.

cites.quote: Pilot testing is a strategy that allows members of your target audience to
review the materials before they are finalized and mass produced.

keyPoints.text: Pilot testing methods include focus groups, in-depth interviews, surveys, and questionnaires.

cites.quote: Pilot testing methods include focus groups, in-depth interviews, surveys, and
